count_semantics.raw: decoded records entering their declared view, including archived copies; split folded forecasts are logical rows; physical stream rows are separately in sources.rows
count_semantics.due_ungraded: due by recorded calendar date only; not market-close eligibility or grading authorization
count_semantics.daily_delta: unique rows whose own dated stamp equals as_of
count_semantics.cells: distinct family/task/horizon groups; not forecast rows

limitations: Cloud stores are not live-enumerated; existing local backup receipts only.
Static consumer names are routing hints, not proof of live consumption.
Protected research outputs are metadata only; no early scores or outcomes.
Parquet data panels use footer metadata only; usable rows and grading unknown.
Quarantine counts identify persisted flags only; the official live/campaign quarantine guard was not invoked, so an absent flag is not proof of eligibility.

population_units_not_to_pool.name: data_catalog
population_units_not_to_pool.receipt: docs/DATA_CATALOG.md summary; receipt absent in checkout

population_units_not_to_pool.name: accepted_output_family_census
population_units_not_to_pool.unit: file-family buckets / task-horizon cells / file counts / decoded record counts (separate semantics)

data_catalog_summary.unit: catalog dataset rows, not events or generated records
data_catalog_summary.freshness: stale summary; full catalog receipt absent from checkout

forecast_accrual_receipt.due_unit: forecast rows due unresolved; separate from accrual

wrds_manifest.unit: parquet files / families / rows, manifest dated 2026-09-04; values not read

typed_event_manifest.scope: manifest count; downstream model/replay consumption not independently receipted

module_manifest.name: Aegis module NIGHT8
module_manifest.scope: manifest scalar/artifact counts only; no artifact scalar values read

alpha_terminal_manifest.name: bars_manifest.json
alpha_terminal_manifest.scope: manifest header keys only; cloud not enumerated; no grading receipt verified

forecast_roster_current_state.unit: separately reported unique forecast records, calendar-due records and immutable overlap; no pooling or grade inference

nn_tableshrink_oct10_run.unit: table rows, grid rows, dated grid dates and task delta are distinct; grid rows are not events
nn_tableshrink_oct10_run.separate_forward_grade_receipt: not located in bounded filename check; do not infer empty
nn_tableshrink_oct10_run.grade_rows_or_outcomes: UNKNOWN_BY_SCOPE; no JSONL rows or protected grade/outcome fields read
nn_tableshrink_oct10_run.source: private R29 summary receipt; no JSONL grade rows or outcome fields read

method_limits: No raw dataset, outcome values, cloud volume, archive members, CRSP/WRDS values, or protected/heldout values were read.
Census is marked complete=false; 507 family routes await/unverified in the accepted review. Inaccessible/protected does not mean empty.

The census defines unique as an immutable identity union within family/task/horizon; cells are distinct family/task/horizon groups; graded means outcome-present rows, no skill metrics; due_ungraded is calendar-date due only.
Do not add row counts across different tasks, observables, horizons, or units. No actual consumer is inferred from static code paths.
Archive header census remains 3,232 headers UNCLASSIFIED under the corrected private receipt; no headers were reclassified here.

Reported 66,546/736/112 forecast populations are not asserted in this manifest because their source receipt was outside this bounded input set; the 766 new-row delta is a distinct Oct 6 receipt, not a cumulative total.
All 791 task/horizon cells are represented: 790 associated to the 519 file-family buckets and one row-only evidence_memory archive cell. Do not infer a missing file-family bucket means empty.
Census `graded` state means outcome-present rows only; it is not evidence of a grader run, skill, or promotion.
The DATA_CATALOG consumer detector is static token search over code/docs indexes (basename/stem/family/directory); it is a candidate reference, not proof a process consumed or graded output.
